content: Kingana kya mukinzi wa longu
Yesu wázonzila hika mu bingana; wuzimbudi:
«Kipfumu kya mazilu kifwanakani yi kyamvu mosi wáta mukinzi wa longu lwa mwana wandi wa yakala.
Amana wátuma basadi bandi benda tela batu bana kátedisa ku mukinzi wa longu; kaasi bázolaku kukwisa.

Wátuma hika basadi bakwawu, mu kuzimbula: "Zimbulenu kwena bana thedisiki: Tala, ngidiki kedi madya mama, miluma mya bangombi yi bambisi bahika ba senga babahondi, byosu byayilama; alwisenu ku mukinzi wa longu!"
Kaasi bawu bálewula, benda kwabawu, mosi wenda ku kilanga kyandi, mukwawu wenda ku kikhita kyandi;
amana bakwawu, bábakwata basadi bandi, bábatukwana, amana bábahonda.
Kyamvu wáyuka khabu: amana buna kátuma baphumbulu bandi, wáhondisa bandwandwa bana yi mbanza ya bawu phi wáyokisaya.
Hanga wuzimbudi kwena basadi bandi: "Mukinzi wa longu wuyilami, kaasi batu babana bátedisa bákalaku kwatakani kikuma kya wawu.
Hangenu lwenda muna phambu za nzila, amana tedisenu, ku mukinzi wa longu, boosu bana lwawána."
Buna bálubuka basadi bana mu nzila, bákutikisa batu boosu bana báwana, ba mbi yi ba mboti; nzu ya mukinzi yábasa yi batu.
Amana buna kákota kyamvu mu kutala batu bana kátedisa, wámona mwamuna mutu mosi wakonda vwata muledi wa mukinzi wa longu.
Amana wumuzimbwadi: "Mukwetu, abweti wukotidi mwamu konda muledi wa mukinzi wa longu?" Kaasi yandi kámonaku kima kya kuvutula.
Hanga kyamvu wuzimbudi kwena basadi: "Mukasenu moku yi malu, amana mulosenu ku nzila kwena phipha; kwakuna kwakála bidilu yi makwenzi."
Mukuma balawu bátela, kaasi bakhunda básolama.»
Phaku ya Khayisala
Hanga bafwadisi bendi kasa kifwandu, bamuleya ndangu bamukwatila mu ndinga.

Amana batumini balonguki ba bawu kwena yandi ha kimosi yi ndambu ya batu bana bakala landa Helodi, mu kuzimbula: «Mulongi, tuzayi ni kyedika wisi zonza ngeyi amana wisi longa nzila ya Nzambi mu masonga. Weku yi bweya bwa mambu mana bisi banza batu mukuma wisiku tala mbunzu za batu.
Tuzimbwaleti si buna wisi banza ngeyi: bulombi mu kufuta phaku ya Khayisala
ho loni?»
Kaasi Yesu, bwosu kázaya mabanza ma bawu ma mbi; wuzimbudi: «Kikuma kya biki lubati ndeyila, bakavungalosi?
Tsongilenu mbongu zina bisi futa phaku.» Bawu bámusongila fwalanga dimosi,
amana wábahyula: «Mbunzu yi khumbu yayi básonika haka, bya nati?»
Bamuzimbwadini: «Bya Khayisala». Hanga wubazimbwadi: «Disongidila, hanenu mambu ma Khayisala kwena Khayisala, amana mambu ma Nzambi kwena Nzambi.»
Buna báyuka bwabuna, báyituka, amana bámusisa, benda kwa bawu.
Kyufu kimosi kikuma kya lufutumuku
Muna kilumbu meni kina, ndambu ya Basadise, bana bisi zimbula ni kweku lufutumuku, bábwesuka kwena yandi, amana bámuhyula
mu kuzimbula: «Mulongi, Moyize kázimbula: "Yuka ni mutu mosi kafwa konda kubuta mwana, myaki wandi kafweti kwela mufwidi ndangu katombula kikanda kya phangi wandi."
Kinga, kwákala kwena betu, yi baphangi ba bayakala tsambwadi; amana watheti wákwela, wáfwa; amana konda kusisa dibuta, wásisa mufwidi wandi kwena myaki wandi.
Busalami phila mosi kwena wuna wazodi, yi watatu, yi kuna kwa wuna watsambwadi.
Amana kunima dya bawu boosu, mukhetu wáfwa.
Mu kilumbu kya lufutumuku, mukhetu wa nani kakala, ha kati dya bawu tsambwadi? Mukuma boosu bámukwela!»
Amana mu kuvutula, Yesu wubazimbwadi: «Luditotisi kikuma lwisiku bakisa keti Masonuku keti ngolu za Nzambi.
Mukuma, ku lufutumuku lwa bafwa kwakálaku yi bayakala keti bakhetu bakwélana, kaasi bakala hanga banzyo mu zilu.
Amana kikuma kya lufutumuku lwa bafwa, lwátangaku mana báluzimbwala kwena Nzambi:
"Meni yena Nzambi wa Bulahami yi Nzambi wa Yizaki yi Nzambi wa Yakobi"? Keku Nzambi wa bafwa kaasi wa bana ba moya.»
Amana buna báyuka bwana, milumba-lumba mya batu báyituka lawu ku malongi mandi.
Mutsiku wuluti mupfunu
Buna báyuka Bafwadisi ni Yesu wábatsukisa Basadise, bákutakana.
Amana mosi hana kati dya bawu, mulongi wa mitsiku, kakala muleya mu kumuhyula:
«Mulongi, khi wawu mutsiku wa mbuta mu mitsiku?»
Yandi wumuvutwadi: «"Watónda Pfumu Nzambi waku yi mbundu yaku yosu, yi moya waku wosu yi ngangu zaku zoosu."
Wawu wenina mutsiku wa mbuta yi watheti.
Amana mutsiku wa zodi, phila mosi yi wuna wa theti: "Tonda khunda waku hanga ngeyi meni."
Mitsiku myami myodi mivungi mitsiku yi Bambikudi.»
Kidisitu yi Tavidi
Bwosu bákutakana Bafwadisi, Yesu wábahyula
mu kuzimbula: «Biki lwisi banza kikuma kya Kidisitu? Mwana wa nati kenina?» Bamuvutwadini: «Wa Tavidi.»
Yandi wubazimbwadi: «Abweti si Tavidi, mu Kitembu kisi mutela ni Pfumu, tangwa kisi zimbula:»

content.text: yi kuna yibásila bambeni baku ku sina dya bitambi byaku."

content: «Disonga yuka ni Tavidi kisi mutela "Pfumu", abweti kakadila mwana wandi?»
Amana ka mutu ku walenda kumuvutwala ndinga mosi. Tuka kilumbu meni kina, ka mutu ku wámeka hika kumuhyula kyufu.

footnotes.text: Ku kisina, Khayisala yákala khumbu ya mutu, kaasi ku manima báyandika kusadilaya hanga khumbu ya «mwata-yamvu», bwosu bazonzidiya haka: «mwata-yamvu wa Loma»
